Lessor accounting moved to BAR under CPA Evolution and is still BAR in the 2026 Blueprint; FAR Area III.F is "Lessee accounting" only. These items count toward FAR practice, mixed sets and readiness.
evidence: far-lsf-14 (selling profit timing), far-lsf-27 (FV 400,000 - carrying 300,000 = 100,000 selling profit), far-lsf-28 (lessor IDC expensed when FV != carrying amount) and the TBS (payment 400,000/4.3121 = 92,762; NIL 331,817; Dr NIL/Cr Sales, Dr COGS/Cr Inventory) are all lessor accounting under ASC 842-30. The keys are technically correct. The lesson (unit title "Leases (Lessee)") has no lessor section. Repo docs/BLUEPRINT_NOTES.md says lessor accounting is "not built as FAR content"; review/reference/far-standards.md 1c and blueprint-notes.md list lessor accounting as BAR. Mcq.optional exists in the schema; the TBS schema has no optional flag, so the TBS cannot be excluded except by moving it.
source: AICPA Uniform CPA Examination Blueprints 2026, FAR Area III.F (Lessee accounting); BAR Area II; review/reference/far-standards.md 1c

issue: The stem asks for the "initial lease liability" when the first payment is made at commencement. ASC 842-20-30-1 measures the lease liability at the PV of lease payments NOT YET PAID, so distractor (d) $133,651 is defensible. The item explanation ("present value of the remaining lease payments at commencement") actually describes (d), which contradicts the key (b), and choice (d)'s rationale ("The first payment is part of the liability") contradicts the item explanation.
evidence: 50,000 x 3.67301 = 183,651 (PV of all 4 payments, the key). Payment 1 is made at commencement, so the PV of the unpaid payments = 183,651 - 50,000 = 133,651 (= 50,000 x 2.67301). The ROU asset = 133,651 + 50,000 paid at commencement = 183,651 either way. far-x3-10 avoids the problem by saying "(before the first payment)"; far-lsf-12 does not.
fix: Add "(before the first payment)" to the stem, as in far-x3-10, or ask for "the present value of the lease payments". Rewrite the explanation: "50,000 x 3.67301 = 183,651, the PV of all four payments including the one due at commencement; the day-1 payment immediately reduces the liability to 133,651." Change (d)'s rationale to "That is the balance after the commencement-date payment."

issue: Skill is mislabeled by two levels: a pure recall question (how a sales-type lessor treats initial direct costs) is labeled "analysis" with difficulty 3.
evidence: The stem asks for one remembered rule (IDC are expensed at commencement when FV != carrying amount) with no facts to analyze or compute. Under the Blueprint, recalling a rule is Remembering & Understanding. Mislabels move the module's skill-mix counts that the Blueprint targets depend on.
fix: If the item is kept (see the lessor-scope finding), relabel it skill: remembering, difficulty: 1 or 2.
